units: <cite ref="Pesachim 40b:12">Pes. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>רבא גופא מָחוּ ליה בחסיסי</he> Ms. M. (insert <cite ref="S00875"><he>קידרא</he></cite>) for R. himself they made a mush with flour of parched grains (v. <cite ref="H01385"><he>חֲסִיסָא</he></cite>); ed. <he>רבא … מחי לה וכ׳</he> (read <he>ליה</he>) R. himself had a mush made for himself &c.
<cite ref="Pesachim 40b:12">Ib.</cite> <he>למֵימַח קדירא וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>למִמְחָה</he>) to make a mush &c. (corresp. to h. <he>מלל</he>).—V. <cite ref="M01112"><he>מֵיחָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 25:8">Targ. Is. XXV, 8</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 32:32">Targ. Ex. XXXII, 32</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 8:4">Targ. Koh. VIII, 4</cite>.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 38a:3">B. Bath. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>איבעי ליה למָחוּיֵי</he> he ought to have entered a protest.

<cite ref="Ketubot 11a:10">Keth. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>מְמָחְיָיא</he> she may protest (against her conversion in childhood). Y. B. Bath. II, 13ᵇ bot. <he>מַמְחִין וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M01970"><he>מַסְמְרָא</he></cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>יכלין … למִימְחֵי בידהון</he> their neighbors may inhibit them.

senses.gloss: (denom. of מוּמְחֶה) to declare approved, to recognize as efficient.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 61b:3">Sabb. 61ᵇ</cite> <he>למחויי גברא</he> (Ms. O. a. Rashi <he>לאַמְחוּיֵי</he>) so as to make the man an approved physician; <he>למ׳ קמיע</he> to consider the amulet as approved.

senses.gloss: to be wiped off;to be blotted out.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 21:13">Targ. II Kings XXI, 13</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 109:13">Targ. Ps. CIX, 13</cite> <he>יִתְמַח</he> ed. Lag. (ed. Wil. <he>יתמחי</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 109:14">Ib. 14</cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Pesachim 74b">Pes. 74ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>חלא מִתְמְחָא</he> Ms. M. 2 a. early eds. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note; ed. <cite ref="M03078"><he>מִתְמְהָא</he></cite>; Ms. M. 1 <cite ref="A03423"><he>אתמהא</he></cite>, corr. acc.) weak vinegar.
<cite ref="Gittin 69a:9">Gitt. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>אִיתְמוּחֵי אִיתְמַח</he> (some ed. <cite ref="E00000"><he>ה</he></cite> for <cite ref="H00000"><he>ח</he></cite>) it (the liver) is dissolved.

senses.gloss: to be declared approved (מוּמְחֶה). Sabb. l. c. א׳ גברא the person has become an approved physician; א׳ קמיע the amulet is considered approved. Ib. 61ᵃ עד דמִמְּחָא גברא ומִמְּחָא קמיע early ed. (later ed. דמומחה … ומומחה, read מי׳; Ms. O. איתמחי, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 1) until both, the person and the amulet, have been approved; a. e.
